name: Doublehorn calicoflower
desc: Doublehorn calicoflower (Downingia bicornuta): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 18 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Downingia bicornuta is a species of flowering plant in the bellflower family known by the common name doublehorn calicoflower and double-horned downingia.
